ImageDescription.value:
Former Hanebuth Mansion (“Haus am Weststrand”) and restaurant “Giftbude”, Norderney, Lower Saxony, Germany
Norderney, a seaside resort founded at the end of the 18th century, has extensive beaches in the west, starting in the east with the supervised West Beach, followed by the supervised North Beach. This is followed by an unsupervised beach stretching to the “Weiße Düne” (White Dune) about 5 kilometers away. Another 2 kilometers away is the Oase Beach with a nudist section.
